body:
I suffer from multiple aliments, worst of which is chronic kidney stones (3-5mm avg. size). Multiple times a year I have to use high doses of opiates, all prescribed, for lengths of time that cause mild to severe withdraw.
Each time, I have reached for gabapentin (300mg). Now, granted, it does not kill all of the symptoms, but has the effect of easing symptoms to a level of tolerance where I can function for the day.
Dosage(s) and combinations:
300-600mg Gabapentin 2-3 times a day
Promethazine 25mg 2-3 times a day
Dyphenhydramine 50-100mg 2-3 times a day.
(Imodium, if available, else don't eat solids during the day!)
Any combination of the above with Gabapentin helps. And I have to ride mountain bike as transportation 20-60 miles a day for work.
Keep in mind the following:
I get random lab UA's, none of the above have any impact at all upon them. And if prescribed, are perfectly legal.
